item.title: DNS Search Domain Audit Failure Visibility
item.description: Field note for making Ansible-based DNS search-domain audits report unreachable hosts, sudo failures, and CSV row-count mismatches instead of silently dropping nodes.

item.title: NetBox Cluster Tag Scope Audit
item.description: Field note for auditing NetBox cluster tags so they can be assigned to virtualization VMs after DCIM-to-VM inventory migration.

item.title: NetBox DCIM Device To VM Migration Dry Run Pattern
item.description: Field note for running an idempotent NetBox DCIM-device to virtualization-VM migration with dry-run evidence, scoped applies, and tag synchronization.

item.title: Operating A NetBox Virtualization Migration Without Losing Control
item.description: A practical operating pattern for migrating NetBox VM inventory from DCIM devices to virtualization VMs while keeping Terraform state, tags, IPs, and audit boundaries under control.

item.title: Classifying vSphere Drift After Terraform Import
item.description: Field note for reading Terraform audit plans after importing existing vSphere VMs and deciding whether to reconcile drift or replace legacy nodes.

item.title: Drift Audit Report: Bringing Existing Kubernetes VMs Under Terraform And NetBox
item.description: A drift audit report for converting VM inventory from NetBox DCIM devices to virtualization objects, importing existing vSphere and NetBox resources into Terraform state, and deciding not to apply unsafe legacy VM drift.

item.title: NetBox DCIM To Virtualization VM Migration
item.description: Field note for recognizing when VMware VMs were modeled as NetBox DCIM devices and migrating them toward virtualization VM objects for Terraform ownership.

item.title: Terraform Import Workflow For Existing vSphere VMs
item.description: Field note for importing existing vSphere and NetBox VM resources into Terraform state so a site can be audited before any apply.
